content.scenario: A consumer purchases a defective electric kettle that explodes, causing damage to their kitchen and injuring their hand. The consumer also experiences mental agony due to the incident.
content.outcome: The consumer can claim compensation for the damage to their kitchen, personal injury, and mental agony under the product liability provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
